result.summary: Found 1 issue: the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the Popular section is truncated, showing as 'Tokumaru Ramer' due to a layout problem.

issues.description: The restaurant name under 'Popular right now' is visually clipped and reads as 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final character cut off, likely because the title and the '4.8 (500+)' rating on the same line do not have enough space.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title row layout to reserve space for the rating element, using flex layout with proper truncation with ellipsis or wrapping so the full name 'Tokumaru Ramen' displays without clipping.
